projects.title: Voicebot — AI Post-Sales Travel Assistant
projects.subtitle: AI voice agent for post-booking travel support, cancellations and human handoffs
projects.description: Built an AI-powered voice assistant prototype for post-booking travel support, designed to help individual and corporate travellers resolve queries, explore cancellation support and escalate complex cases to a human agent. The project focuses on reducing repetitive support effort and creating a smoother customer experience through conversational interactions and structured handoffs. Includes a live interactive prototype and supporting case study.

projects.title: AI Visa Assistant

projects.description: An internal AI assistant built around a RAG/NLP approach. companies.desc:
I’m a Business Analyst at Cognizant with a PGDM in Marketing & Operations, working at the intersection of business, technology, and customer experience. My experience includes translating business problems into product requirements, defining user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritizing features, and collaborating with engineering teams through development and UAT.

I’ve also driven an AI-powered Visa Assistant initiative that reduced query turnaround time from approximately one hour to 15 minutes, and built an AI Voice Travel Agent prototype focused on post-booking travel journeys, including booking queries, cancellations, and intelligent human handoffs.

Through these projects, I bring a combination of product thinking, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder management, and hands-on AI solutioning. I’m interested in building intuitive, data-driven travel experiences that simplify customer journeys and improve operational efficiency at MakeMyTrip
